text: Imago [Lat.]: (the same in the other languages). The perfect or winged stage of those insects which pass through a complete METAMORPHOSIS (q.v.); it is in this stage only that the sexual organs are mature. Literature : COMSTOCK, Introd. to the Study of Insects; PACKARD, Entomology; KORSCHELT and HEIDER, Entwickelungsgesch. d. Wirbellosen. ( C.S.M. )
